description: This file defines a base class 'BaseRule' for processing metadata rules in SuiteCRM, including methods for parsing panels, matching field names, and handling custom fields.

classes.name: BaseRule
classes.description: A utility base class providing methods for parsing panels, matching patterns, and identifying custom fields in SuiteCRM metadata processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the BaseRule class.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Pre-processing hook that by default returns the panels unchanged.

methods.name: postParse
methods.description: Post-processing hook that by default calls parsePanels.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Method for parsing and possibly modifying panels; default implementation returns panels unchanged.

methods.name: isCustomField
methods.description: Checks if a given field/mixed value is a custom field based on naming convention.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the name of a field/mixed matches a provided regular expression.

methods.name: getMatch
methods.description: Returns the matches from a regex match on the field/mixed name.
